pageTitle: Historical Memoirs of New California, vol. 1 (Palóu; ed. Bolton, 1926), plate facing p. xxiv
author: Anonymous painter (painting in the Museo Nacional, Mexico); reproduced in Historical Memoirs of New California, ed. Herbert Eugene Bolton
credit: University of California Press, Berkeley, 1926 (scan: Internet Archive, from the Dominican College Library, San Rafael)
medium: halftone plate of an oil portrait painting, head and shoulders in Franciscan habit
subjectEvidence: The printed caption on the plate reads: "Portrait of Father Palóu. From the painting in the Museo Nacional, Mexico. With facsimile of signature." The book's text records it as the frontispiece to the introduction at page xxiv.
license: Public domain (US publication 1926; the painting is 18th century)
rightsStatement: The Internet Archive item page carries no licence or rights field. The basis is the publication date: the title page reads University of California Press, Berkeley, 1926, and US works published in 1926 entered the public domain on 1 January 2022. The underlying painting is far older. This is a date-based determination, not a statement on the page.
scaled: Cropped from the scanned plate page (1896×2856 px) to the portrait (1318×1294 px), then resized to 500x491 px; no other edits. The attribution to Palóu rests on the 1926 caption; the painting's painter is not recorded.
